title: Ratios and rates
summary: Simplifying ratios, dividing in a ratio, scale drawings, rates, speed and the unitary method.

cards.title: Simplifying ratios
cards.rule: Divide both parts by the HCF. Use the same units first.
cards.tip: convert to the same units before you simplify.

cards.title: Solving ratio problems
cards.rule: Add the parts, find one part, then multiply.
lines: In the ratio 3 : 5 with the first part 12: the second is \(20\)

cards.title: Scale drawings
cards.rule: A scale of 1 : 100 means 1 cm on the drawing is 100 cm in real life.
lines: 1 : 100, 4.5 cm on the plan: \(4.5 \times 100 = 450\) cm, or 4.5 m
1 : 50 000, 3 cm on the map: 150 000 cm, or 1.5 km
Finding the scale: a 6 m wall drawn 3 cm long is 3 cm : 600 cm = **1 : 200**
cards.tip: use the same units on both sides of the scale.

cards.title: Introducing rates
cards.rule: A rate compares two different units. Read "per" as "for each".
lines: Best buy: 2 L for $5 is $2.50/L; 3 L for $6.60 is $2.20/L, so the **3 L** is better value

cards.title: Solving rate problems
cards.rule: Multiply the rate by the time, or divide to find the time.
lines: Typing 45 words a minute for 20 minutes: \(45 \times 20 = 900\) words
cards.note: Check the units match before you multiply or divide.

cards.title: The unitary method
cards.rule: Find the value of one, then multiply to get what you need.
lines: 5 pens cost $8: 1 pen is $1.60, so 12 pens are \(\$19.20\)
In a ratio, 3 parts = 45: 1 part is 15, so 7 parts are \(105\)
cards.note: Finding the value of one works for any amount.
